name: WayriCAD Quick SI
description: Screen routed signal delay, electrical length and resistive terminations; retain impedance and I2C checks.
description_full: Read-only Quick SI screening from actual routed endpoints: propagation delay, electrical length, lossless resistive reflections and series-termination candidates with explicit stackup assumptions. Native route preview, local HTML reports and CLI. Retains impedance, differential skew, reference-layer and I2C checks. This is engineering screening, not full-wave or eye simulation.
